verdicts.reason: A: the 'Sunset Sessions' headline is barely bigger than the body copy. The italic subtitle wraps and leaves 'hour of the year' orphaned on its own line. The RSVP button and pills are shrunk to tiny chips jammed against the right edge, so the CTA is buried, and the ticket graphic is lost. B: the time/location line on the left is the largest text and overpowers the small, crowded centre headline, so the hierarchy is wrong. The pills are scattered (FREE ENTRY sits next to RSVP, TASTINGS is pushed far right) and the URL text is unreadably small. B is marginally better because the RSVP button and ticket graphic stay visible.
